project: KP DsbA + Irp3 natural product screening
notes: Grid box parameters for AutoDock Vina, calculated as the centroid of CA atoms of validated pocket-lining residues (Biopython), computed on the fully prepped structures (hydrogens added, geometry cleaned).

DsbA.validation: Confirmed via CASTpFold — largest detected pocket (~723 Å²), includes Tyr112

Irp3.active_site: Tyr129 (catalytic general acid; equivalent to Tyr128 in Y. enterocolitica numbering, PDB 5KVS)
Irp3.validation: Literature (PDB 5KVS, Meneely & Lamb 2016) + sequence alignment (+1 residue offset resolved) + CASTpFold (dominant pocket ~4695 Å², includes Tyr129)
Irp3.note: Full CASTp pocket (66 residues) spans an unusually large area reflecting the NRPS-module-binding surface, not a compact small-molecule site. Focused subset (13 residues, centered on Tyr129) used for the actual docking grid box below.
